The predecessor ofVinacafé Bien Hoa Joint Stock Company was the Coronel Coffee Factory, established in 1969 with a designed capacity of 80 tons of instant coffee per year, with all machinery and equipment imported from Germany. On December 29, 2004, Bien Hoa Coffee Factory was converted from a State-Owned Enterprise into a Joint Stock Company and renamed Bien Hoa Vinacafé Joint Stock Company (Vinacafé BH). Vinacafé Bien Hoa is recognized as the leading instant coffee manufacturer in Vietnam, having successfully developed the two brands Vinacafé and Wake-Up, capturing 41% of the instant coffee market.
